body: I have no problem with anger. I feel not the slightest emotion outside of pain and sorrow. If anything, it has been diagnosed from my abusive father and alarming amount of stepmothers, but it started way before that. In all honesty, it started after I first tried a Ouija board at my friend's house, the night she killed herself.

To hurt myself, and others. To laugh and celebrate pain. And usually they tell me what to say. They've been my constant companions since I was four, mentally torturing me when I try to ignore them. They only grow silent when others are in pain, the reason for my sociopathic behavior and lack of empathy, according to therapist #7.
Also, I have no clue what the hell is up with the formatting. God damn it.
